Cricket: Samson's Poor Form Sparks Debate on Suryavanshi's Debut

Sanju Samson's recent batting performance in the T20 series against England has been criticized, with scores of 5, 0, and 1 in three matches. This has led to discussions about whether 15-year-old Vaibhav Suryavanshi will get an opportunity to debut for the Indian team. Several former cricketers, including Sunil Gavaskar and Ravi Shastri, have commented on the delay in Suryavanshi's debut, with Gavaskar expressing concern about mounting pressure on the young player. Coach Gautam Gambhir's potential team selection strategies are also being analyzed as a factor in Suryavanshi's inclusion.
